title: Rooke Humsheeer ne Kaha Bhaiya
body:
Rooke humsheeer ne kaha bhaiya
Aye garibul watan Raza bhaiya
1. Waswase dil mein mere aate hai kyun shaher hai yeh ghamzada bhaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kamsini mein taqi pa vavaila
Dour yateema ka aa gaya bhaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Haaye kisne zaher diya tumko
Kya woh muslim na tha Raza bhaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Mein madine se aayi hoon milne
Kis taraf ho mere Raza bhaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Uth gaye tum jahan se gurbat mein aur na aayee mujhe qaza bhaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Bin tumhare mein ji na paoungi
Kab se karti hoon ilteja bhaiya
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Mein bhi shamil hoon gham mein saath tere
Aaee zehra ki yeh sada bhaiya
